Add SE-EDU Java standard skill
commitResults.messageBody:
Java changes need a shared project rule set so future edits are easier to review consistently.

Add a project-specific Codex skill for the SE-EDU Java basic and intermediate coding standard. Mandate that skill from AGENTS.md so Java source and test changes follow the same expectations.

Let's also clean up the current code where the new standard reveals simple naming, Javadoc, and spacing issues.

Keeping the standard as a local skill makes the rule set reusable without copying the full external guide into every prompt.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add SE-EDU Git standard skill
commitResults.messageBody:
Git work needs a shared project rule set so future commit messages, branch names, tags, and push steps stay consistent with the course conventions.

Let's add a project-specific Codex skill for the SE-EDU Git standard and require it from AGENTS.md for future Git-related work.

Keeping the rules in a skill makes the convention reusable while keeping AGENTS.md focused on project-level requirements.
